title: Number Merge 2048
description: Slide the tiles, merge matching numbers, and reach 2048 in this original mobile-friendly puzzle game.
instructions: Use arrow keys or WASD to move. Swipe or tap the arrows on mobile. Merge matching tiles to reach 2048.

title: Neon Dodger
description: Dodge falling neon blocks, survive as long as you can, and beat your high score.
instructions: Use ← → or A/D keys, or tap the left and right buttons to dodge the falling blocks.

title: Memory Flip
description: Flip the cards, find matching pairs, and clear the board in as few moves as possible.
instructions: Tap or click two cards to find matching pairs. Match all eight pairs to win.

title: Lane Rush
description: Race down a busy road, switch lanes to avoid traffic, and chase your distance record.
instructions: Use left/right arrows or A/D, or tap the lane buttons to switch lanes and avoid cars.

title: Tic Tac Tactics
description: Challenge a clever computer opponent in this clean, quick strategy classic.
instructions: You are X. Tap an empty square to play. Get three in a row before the computer does.

title: Word Scramble
description: Unscramble mixed-up everyday words, use hints wisely, and build your streak.
instructions: Rearrange the letters to form the hidden word. Type your answer and press Check. Use Hint if you get stuck.
